_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Transcription cards use the queued-message cancel and retry RPCs. The test seeded a conversation at /c/{{SLUG}} whose server data reports two queued transcriptions: one still working on /tmp/shelley-uploads/working.webm with the context "Keep working draft", and one of /tmp/shelley-uploads/failed.webm that failed with "transcription unavailable", with the context "Keep failed draft". The live event stream is cut off. Requests to cancel or retry a queued message (POST /api/conversation/<id>/cancel-queued?queued_id=<id> and .../retry-queued?queued_id=<id>) succeed without effect. Calls "stopRequest", "retryRequest" and "cancelRequest" return the method of the first request whose URL contains "/cancel-queued?queued_id=q-working", "/retry-queued?queued_id=q-failed" and "/cancel-queued?queued_id=q-failed" respectively ("none" before there is one). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"]. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for the message input to be visible.
2. Call "stopRequest" should return "none" (nothing sent yet). Click [data-testid="transcription-stop-button"]. Call "stopRequest" should return "POST". The message input should have the value "Keep working draft".
3. Fill the message input with "" (empty it).
4. Call "retryRequest" should return "none". Click [data-testid="transcription-retry-button"]. Call "retryRequest" should return "POST". The message input should have the value "" (empty).
5. Call "cancelRequest" should return "none". Click [data-testid="transcription-cancel-button"]. Call "cancelRequest" should return "POST". The message input should have the value "Keep failed draft".
